method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING with a NOTHING-kind tag where it does not answer); dates in a small module, the rules in one module and the claimant's questions in a seat module importing it; one regulative rule (the time bar) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Limitation Act 1974 (Tas), No. 98 of 1974, consolidated version published 2024-07-18 and current at point in time 2026-11-06, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/act-1974-098.txt (text sha256 af438489217489f460ca4175f4164883be2802db4d16f65989fd487676fada09), retrieved from legislation.tas.gov.au on 2026-11-06

seat: the claimant: the individual to whom a right of action accrues and who brings or proposes to bring the action (injured person, family member suing under the Fatal Accidents Act 1934, personal representative, survivor of child abuse, party to a contract or deed, creditor, beneficiary of a trust or estate, person who paid a tax not owed) (tla-seat.l4); the s 35 question is asked by the same individual answering a claim with a counterclaim

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run tla-dates.l4 ; l4 run tla-rules.l4 ; l4 run tla-seat.l4 ; l4 run tla-cases.l4
checks.result: 132 assertions written, 132 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics were read; satisfied assertions were counted by distinct source range. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

Out: ss 1, 3, 37, 38A(1), (2), (4), 39, 40, Schedule 1 (machinery, transitional); ss 4(1)(b), (c), (2), (6), 6, 7, 9 (recognizances, awards, accounts, penalties, goods, contribution, equity); s 8(1), (3), (5), (6) (admiralty in rem, salvage); ss 10-23A, 26(4), 29(1)-(3), (5), 31(1)-(4), (6), (9), (10) (land and mortgages); s 25D(1) (pre-1993 payments); ss 26(5), 28, 32(2); Part IIIA (choice of law); ss 33, 34, 36.
